title: Apple releases HomeView smart home hub with screen as showcase for Siri AI
summary: Apple launched HomeView, a new smart home hub with a display designed to showcase Siri AI capabilities. The company also introduced the Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini as part of its smart home ecosystem expansion.
content: The iPhone maker also announced the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini.

title: Martin Shkreli violated lifetime pharma industry ban, FTC and states say in contempt claim
summary: Federal regulators allege that Martin Shkreli violated a lifetime ban from the pharmaceutical industry by engaging in prohibited activity. Shkreli was originally banned after a conviction for organizing an illegal monopoly scheme involving the drug Daraprim.
content: Shkreli was banned from the pharmaceutical industry after a trial found that he organized an illegal scheme to perpetuate a monopoly for the drug Daraprim.

zh.title: 马丁·施克雷利违反终身制药业禁令，FTC和各州提出藐视法庭指控

title: This one move will save $20,000 on our wedding

content: Plus: Where we’re cutting back to free up space in our wedding budget for the things we really want on our big day

title: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 could be a really challenging year for the stock market
summary: Billionaire investor Paul Tudor Jones warned that 2027 could present significant challenges for equities as corporate buybacks and M&A activity that have supported the bull market face headwinds. The outlook suggests a potential reversal of key market tailwinds.

title: Why this little known Chinese chipmaker has caused a global stock rout

content: China's leading memory chipmaker CXMT has reportedly made progress on new designs.
